extracted.intended_audience: freelance editorial professionals and clients seeking guidance on industry rates (editors, proofreaders, designers, writers, publishers)
extracted.subtask_description: A reference and benchmarking chart of median and mean rates for a wide range of editorial, design, publishing, reading, transcription, translation, and writing services, plus tools (rate estimator/converter) and methodological notes based on an EFA member survey.

rubrics_metrics.name: About these rates (survey methodology and caveats)
rubrics_metrics.description: The median rate ranges in the 2026 Rate Chart are based on data from a survey administered to EFA members from November 2025 through mid-January 2026. Over 1,100 respondents answered questions about services and rates for the 2025 calendar year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EFA neither sets rates nor advises members on what rates to use. Individual members’ rates may vary considerably depending on type of work, turnaround time, degree of expertise, local cost of living, training, and years of experience. Response counts vary by question because members were instructed to respond only to applicable questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rate units and reported statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Rates are reported in multiple types: per word, per hour, per page, pages/hour, and per project (250 words used as a project-unit example). Each cell shows mean and median values and (where applicable) ranges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The median is the rate exactly in the middle of a given range (equal number of values above and below). Upper and lower estimates are determined by a percentage based on average variations from median rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial rate estimator (tool usage)
rubrics_metrics.description: A tool to obtain an estimated cost for a specific project using 2025 survey data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To use: choose 'Per word' or 'Per hour'; select the service type (editing, publishing, reading, consulting, etc.) and type/genre of project (academic, fiction, nonfiction, etc.); enter total word count. Estimated range may not reflect any particular practitioner's rates; rates vary by experience, training, and other factors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rate converter (tool)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tool to convert between different rate types (per hour/page/word).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the rate converter to translate estimates across billing units (per word ↔ per hour ↔ per page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Consulting (rate category)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consulting services reported with per-word/per-hour/per-page/pages/hr/per-project metrics (e.g., Coaching, Query Letter Coaching, Marketing and Promotion, Project Management, Other Consulting).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consulting rates vary greatly and depend on project type and duration; larger differences between mean and median indicate wider variation. 'Other Consulting' examples: brainstorming, dissertation development, grant writing, pitch development, proposal development, strategic communications, writing workshops.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design (rate category)
rubrics_metrics.description: Graphic and layout design rates reported across media: book covers, books and print media, eBooks, signage, swag, websites, and other media; includes layout and 'Other Design' examples.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some entries show per-word/per-hour ranges and pages/hr values (e.g., book covers, websites). 'Other Design' examples include desktop publishing, handouts, magazines, mapmaking, newsletters. Several cells may be 'n/a' where not applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyediting (Editing: copyediting)
rubrics_metrics.description: Copyediting rates broken out by genre and client type (academic humanities student vs faculty/publication, academic STEM, business/marketing, children's categories, fiction, graphic novels, legal, medical, memoirs, nonfiction, technical, etc.). Example: Fiction copyediting: 2.0–2.7¢ per word; $40.00–$50.00 per hour; 5.0–10.0 pages/hr.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rates vary by genre and client type; pages/hour estimates provided to help translate per-hour and per-page pricing. Some specialized fields (medicolegal) show 'n/a' for certain rate types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developmental Editing
rubrics_metrics.description: Developmental editing rates reported by genre and client type (academic, business/marketing, children’s, fiction, graphic novels, legal, medical, memoirs, nonfiction, technical, other). Example: Fiction developmental editing: 3.0–3.5¢ per word; $52.50–$70.00 per hour; 5.5–10.0 pages/hr.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certain genres (e.g., medical, medicolegal) may show higher hourly ranges or 'n/a' for per-word rates. Use pages/hr to estimate throughput for per-project pricing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: Formatting rates by genre/client (academic student vs faculty, business/marketing, children's categories, fiction, graphic novels, legal, medical, memoirs, nonfiction, technical, other). Example: Fiction formatting: 1.1–1.4¢ per word; $52.50–67.50 per hour; 10.0–20.0 pages/hr.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some children's categories show very different per-word values (e.g., children’s board book entries). 'n/a' appears where not applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Line Editing
rubrics_metrics.description: Line-editing rates broken out by genre and client type (similar taxonomy to copyediting/developmental editing). Example: Fiction line editing: 2.7–3.5¢ per word; $50.00–$60.00 per hour; 5.0–9.5 pages/hr.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Graphic novels and specialized genres show wider ranges; pages/hr help translate per-hour pricing into throughput.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proofreading
rubrics_metrics.description: Proofreading rates by genre and client type (academic, business, children’s, fiction, graphic novels, legal, medical, memoirs, nonfiction, technical, other). Example: Fiction proofreading: 1.2–2.0¢ per word; $35.00–$45.00 per hour; 10.0–15.0 pages/hr.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proofreading pages/hr tends to be higher than developmental/line editing; specialized medical/legal proofreading shows higher hourly rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Editing (specialized services)
rubrics_metrics.description: Catch-all for specialized editorial services such as 508 accessibility, audiobooks, competitive analyses, picture book editing, plain language editing, resumes, white papers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These services may report per-word or per-hour values that differ substantially from mainstream categories; examples given to illustrate scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publishing (book proposals, indexing, permissions, research and fact-checking, self-publishing assistance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Publishing-category rates include Book Proposal (book/eBook), Indexing (book/eBook/website), Permissions, Research and Fact-Checking (fact-checking and research), Self-Publishing Assistance (electronic/print/both), and 'Other Publishing' examples.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some publishing entries include per-project examples (e.g., Book Proposal per-project values shown). 'Other Publishing' examples include coaching, distribution assistance, journal submission management, picture research, press/market research, publisher research, reference checking and formatting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reading (beta reading, manuscript assessment, sensitivity/authenticity reading, other reading)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rates for evaluative reading services: Beta Reading (e.g., 0.5–0.8¢/word; $50–$70/hr; 16–40 pages/hr), Manuscript Assessment/Evaluation (1.5–1.8¢/word; $40–$54/hr), Sensitivity/Authenticity Reading (1.0–1.8¢/word depending on type), and Other Reading services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some reading services include combined 'sensitivity and authenticity' metrics; 'Other Reading' examples include accessibility to non-academic readers, chapter guidance, cold reading, conceptual clarity, submissions reading.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transcription
rubrics_metrics.description: Transcription rates reported in terms of per-audio minute, per hour, per page; also reports audio minutes per hour and minutes per hour (e.g., $1.50–$1.75 per audio minute; $52.50–$57.50 per hour).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Transcription is charged in terms of per-audio minute, per hour, and audio minutes per hour. Pages/hr and minutes/hr provided to gauge throughput.

rubrics_metrics.name: Translation
rubrics_metrics.description: Translation rates for work 'From English' and 'To English' reported per word, per hour, per page, and pages/hr. Example: From English: 12.0–19.0¢ per word; $60.00–$75.00 per hour; 1.0–2.0 pages/hr.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rates vary by direction of translation and language complexity; low pages/hr values reflect time-intensive nature of translation work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing (curriculum development, ghostwriting, short-form/full-length writing, technical/scientific, other writing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Writing rates broken out by service: Curriculum Development (primary/secondary/undergraduate/graduate), Ghostwriting (articles, blog posts, business, fiction full-length, graphic novels, journalism, memoir, nonfiction), and other writing service types with per-word/per-hour/per-page/pages/hr metrics. Example: Short story ghostwriting: 3.0–4.0¢ per word; $75–$100/hr; 1.0–3.0 pages/hr.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Many writing categories show wide ranges (e.g., business/marketing highest per-word/per-project). 'Other Writing' examples include book reviews, children's board books, devotionals, exhibition materials, grant writing, press releases, query letters, screenplays/scripts, social media posts, speechwriting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work-for-Hire (distinct pricing/terms within writing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Work-for-hire rates for articles, blog posts, business/marketing, fiction full-length, graphic novels, journalism, legal/medical where applicable; reported per-word/per-hour/per-page/pages/hr. Example: Fiction full-length work-for-hire: 13.5¢–20.0¢ per word; $80–$100/hr; 5.0–10.0 pages/hr.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work-for-hire entries highlight different pricing than ghostwriting and often imply transfer of rights; specialty categories like medical/legal may have higher or 'n/a' values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclaimers and variability signals
rubrics_metrics.description: Notes throughout the chart indicate where entries are 'n/a', where mean vs median differ substantially, and where sample sizes/response variability affect interpretation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use median as a central tendency measure; large differences between mean and median or 'n/a' cells indicate either skewed data or insufficient responses for that cell. Contact EFA for questions about the chart or estimator.
